BenchConfig: Base Configuration for Benchmarks

Source: R/04f-ClassBenchConfig.R
BenchConfig.Rd

BenchConfig is the common parent of the benchmark configurations in SigBridgeR. It stores the inputs shared by every screening method (matched_bulk, sc_data, phenotype, label_type, phenotype_class, screen_method), the method specific arguments collected in method_param, and an optional param list used by subclasses that forward extra arguments.

Usage

BenchConfig(
  matched_bulk,
  sc_data,
  phenotype,
  label_type = "{method_name}",
  phenotype_class = c("binary", "survival", "continuous"),
  screen_method = names(ScreenStrategy),
  method_param = MethodParamSet(),
  sigbridger_version = get_pkg_version(),
  ...
)

Arguments

matched_bulk

matrix or data.frame. Bulk expression data (genes x samples) matching phenotype. Shared by all methods.

sc_data

A Seurat object to be screened.

phenotype

Phenotype data, either a named vector or a patient survival data frame. See Screen().

label_type

character or NULL. Length-one glue-style template for the phenotype label type, with {method_name} available. When NULL or not of length one, it falls back to "{method_name}" with an informational message.

phenotype_class

character. One or more of "binary", "continuous", "survival". Default: all three.

screen_method

character. One or more method names registered in ScreenStrategy, giving the methods to benchmark and their order. Default: "Scissor".

method_param

Named list of method-specific arguments, each passed only to the executor of the method it is named after (e.g. list(Scissor_param = list(alpha = 0.05))). Default: MethodParamSet(), i.e. one empty entry per registered method.

sigbridger_version

Package Version of SigBridgeR

...

unused

Value

A BenchConfig S7 object.

Details

A single configuration may describe several screening runs: the benchmark screens the same data with each method listed in screen_method, one method at a time.

  • screen_method may only contain methods registered in ScreenStrategy (e.g. "Scissor", "scPAS", "LP_SGL"); the constructor of the concrete configuration aborts on any unknown name. It also aborts when the selected methods have no phenotype class in common.

  • method_param is a named list with one entry per method, named "<method>_param" (e.g. list(Scissor_param = list(alpha = 0.05))). Each entry is spliced into the arguments of that method's executor, after its ScreenMethod mapper has run. Use MethodParamSet() to build the full set with empty defaults, so unspecified methods simply run with their own defaults.

  • label_type is a length-one template. The default "{method_name}" is resolved by the benchmark with the name of the method currently being benchmarked, so a single configuration can serve methods whose executors expect differently named phenotype labels.

See also

Other S7-Classes: AnnotationMethod(), BenchAccConfig(), BenchGSEAConfig(), BenchGeneScoreConfig(), BenchMemoryConfig(), ScreenMethodCache(), ScreenMethodConfig(), ScreenMethodResult()
